{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Long-sleeve top: fitted crew-neck tee, hip length, cream #F1E7D3, soft cotton jersey
Sweater: relaxed crew-neck pullover, hip length, olive #7D8260, fine merino wool
Trousers: straight-leg jeans, full ankle length, dark indigo #2F3B52, stretch cotton denim
Outer layer: field jacket with a straight cut, hip length, camel #B58B5A, cotton twill with a light lining
Shoes: low sneakers with a cushioned, flexible rubber sole, off-white #F2EEE6, smooth leather
Scarf: wide, light scarf, sage-grey #8FA59C, soft wool-blend
Bag: small crossbody with a zip closure, cognac #8A5A3B, grained leather

This outfit suits a cool autumn day of walking, because the tee, sweater and jacket can be taken off or added as the temperature changes between shady streets and sunny squares. Cushioned sneakers and stretch denim keep you comfortable for nine hours on cobblestones, and the crossbody bag leaves your hands free. The warm olive, camel and cream tones go well with your golden hair and warm skin, and the sage scarf picks up the grey-green of your eyes.
